name: Obligation-First
description: An open upper schema for normative content (laws, cases, joint interpretations) bound to Semantic Arts gist.

concepts.vocabulary_prefix: https://w3id.org/of/v1/ is the planned permanent vocabulary prefix. It will resolve to https://obligationfirst.org/v1/ once the w3id.org redirect is filed. Until then, https://obligationfirst.org/v1/ is the live CI-verified resolution target and records should use @context: https://obligationfirst.org/v1/.
concepts.id_federation: Record @id values are adopter-local, opaque, and permanent. An @id identifies the adopter's record about a legal entity, not the entity's canonical external identifier. Obligation-First does not prescribe slug grammar; each adopter declares its own. A namespace reorganization MUST keep the old @id resolving via HTTP 301 (W3C 'Cool URIs Don't Change'); a rename is therefore not a breaking change. Added in v0.3.
concepts.identifier_crosswalks: Standard identifiers ride as typed crosswalks on the record, never as the @id. Cross-adopter joins key on crosswalks, not slugs. Matrix (RFC 2119, conditional on coverage): ELI (eli_uri, MUST for instruments where the jurisdiction issues ELIs), ECLI / neutral_citation (MUST for citable court decisions), Akoma Ntoso (akn_uri, SHOULD/MAY where an AKN representation exists), urn:lex (MAY, fallback where no ELI), Wikidata QID (sameAs, SHOULD for authorities with an entry), EuroVoc concept (sameAs/exactMatch, SHOULD where the subject has a concept). Added in v0.3.
concepts.naming_profiles: Each adopter publishes a naming profile, a JSON-LD of:NamingProfile document served at /.well-known/obligation-first-naming-profile.jsonld (application/ld+json) and validated by https://obligationfirst.org/v1/schema/naming-profile.schema.json. It declares, per entity type, VoID uriSpace and uriRegexPattern plus an RFC 6570 uriTemplate and a list of supplied crosswalks. A flat text/plain provenance sidecar at /.well-known/obligation-first-naming-profile-manifest.txt carries profile-sha256 and profile-bytes. The profile is adopter-owned and descriptive of what the adopter actually mints; Obligation-First consumes and validates against it, and never prescribes the slug grammar. Required to be 'bound' (Level 2). Concept added in v0.3; format defined in v0.4.
concepts.jurisdiction: Jurisdiction is a typed ISO 3166 field (gist:Jurisdiction with an ISO 3166-1 or 3166-2 ref, e.g. us-co, us-ut, ca-bc, eu), never a slug component. MUST at Level 2. Added in v0.3.
concepts.reparation_gist_binding: gist:Requirement (secondary duty) + gist:Intention (declared intent on creating Term) + gist:Event (actuated reparation, via proceeding strand) — v0.2 binding-only refinement per Semantic Arts feedback; of:Reparation class preserved
concepts.allegation_gist_binding: gist:Content (assertion text) + gist:Intention (only when the claim is itself intent-bearing — libel, fraud, defamation). gist defines no gist:Statement class. Refined in v0.2 per Semantic Arts feedback.

relations.defeats: Term → Term[] — Term-level override, LegalRuleML §7.4 (general / fallback)
relations.rebuts: Term → Term[] — subproperty of defeats; opposite-conclusion case (LegalRuleML §7.4). Added in v0.2.
relations.undercuts: Term → Term[] — subproperty of defeats; denies-applicability case (LegalRuleML §7.4). Added in v0.2.
relations.violationOf: Reparation → Obligation — inverse of triggers_on_violation_of; Obligation-side assertion. Added in v0.2.
relations.wouldSupersede: Instrument → Instrument[] — subjunctive form for proposed Instruments
relations.executableEncoding: Term | Obligation → typed reference (Catala / Blawx / OpenFisca / others)
